item.title: Deploy WordPress and MySQL with Persistent Volumes
item.description: In this tutorial you deploy WordPress backed by a MySQL database, and you give both tiers storage that outlives their Pods. You import the two Kubernetes example manifests into one design, add the Secret that holds the database password, and add the PersistentVolumes that the claims bind to. Stateless Pods can be replaced at any moment; a database cannot lose its files when that happens. This tutorial shows how Kubernetes separates the data from the Pod, and exactly which pieces a deploy creates and an undeploy removes.
